_note: Pre-registered per-seed P3-carrier hashes for zinc_shared_factor_supplement_v1.
The frozen config configs/sf_atomic_v1.json pins the carrier as a single scalar,
which is the seed-0 value; it was not changed (sha256 d1f6b67f...). Later seeds were
not part of that pre-registration, so sf_runner.gate reads the seed->carrier map here.
Values were computed from the frozen init procedure (same SSL checkpoint, same
LM.hash_tensors(public_state(model)) definition) and cross-checked against the
frozen per-seed init/content hashes in the config before any run: for seeds 0 and 1
and arms D/T/N the recomputed init and content hashes equal the config values.
They are declared BEFORE training and are not results.
